newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet stable, possible arb from Carib/Med.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet stable, possible arb from Carib/Med.

text.p: NWE jet fuel differentials were stable but business was inactive on Friday, traders said.
Cargo action was on hold while traders await the possible fixing of arbitrage barrels to northern Europe from the Caribbean and Mediterranean.
Cargo spreads were notionally around Aug IPE +$15/$15.50. Barges were assessed at around Aug IPE +$19 and stalled by a standoff between buyers and sellers.
